submissions.title: Louisville Metro Council advances data center moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Planning and Zoning Committee voted 7-1 to approve a 180-day moratorium on new hyperscale data centers
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Louisville / Jefferson County, KY. Metro Council's Planning & Zoning Committee voted 7-1 on Aug 4, 2026 to advance a 180-day (6-month) moratorium barring city planners from approving new hyperscale data center construction until comprehensive regulations are adopted. Full 26-member Metro Council final vote expected roughly Aug 11-13, 2026 -- not yet enacted.
